note_title: 证明乘积不等式与Γ函数
summary_en: This note studies the inequality \(\prod_{n=1}^{N}\left(1-\frac{1}{2n}\right)<\frac{1}{\sqrt{2N}}\) through several approaches: logarithmic transformation, termwise estimates, telescoping via concavity of \(\log\), and a sharper derivation using the Gamma and Beta functions. It also states and proves Gautschi's inequality as the special-function tool behind the Gamma-function approach.

problems.statement_en: An equivalent formulation of Problem 1 is to prove that \[\sum_{n=1}^{N}\log\left(1-\frac{1}{2n}\right)<-\frac{1}{2}\log(2N).\]
prerequisites: equivalence of product and sum forms

problems.statement_en: Let \(H_N\) denote the \(N\)-th harmonic number. Then for every positive integer \(N\), \[H_N>\log N+\frac{1}{2}.\]
problems.statement_zh:
$H_N$表示第$N$个调和数，那么对任意正整数$N$都有
$$H_N>\log(N)+\frac{1}{2}$$

problems.statement_en: For \(s\in(0,1)\) and \(x>0\), Gautschi's inequality states that \[x^{1-s}<\frac{\Gamma(x+1)}{\Gamma(x+s)}<(1+x)^{1-s}.\]
If \(g(x)=\log\Gamma(x)\), then \(g\) is convex on \((0,\infty)\); equivalently, for \(u\neq v\), \[g(tu+(1-t)v)<tg(u)+(1-t)g(v),\] and hence \[\Gamma(tu+(1-t)v)<\Gamma(u)^t\Gamma(v)^{1-t}.\]
problems.statement_zh:
令$g(x)=\log\left(\Gamma(x)\right)$那么:$$g(tu+(1-t)v)<tg(u)+(1-t)g(v),u\neq v$$
对数下凸性自然也可以写成:$$\Gamma(tu+(1-t)v)<\Gamma(u)^t\Gamma(v)^{1-t}$$

key_techniques_discussed: transforming a product inequality into a logarithmic sum inequality
isolating the dominant error term before estimation
constructing telescoping sums using concavity of \(\log\)
rewriting products using Beta and Gamma functions
applying Gautschi's inequality via log-convexity of the Gamma function
